MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Cruise"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coStar:Person) WHERE tom <> coStar RETURN m.title AS Movie, collect(coStar.name) AS CoStars
MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActors:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT coActors) AS NumberOfCoActors

MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActor:Person) WHERE tom <> coActor RETURN coActor.name AS ActorName, m.title AS MovieTitle, m.released AS MovieReleaseDate, (m.released - coActor.born) AS ActorAgeAtReleaseDate

MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActor:Person) WHERE tom <> coActor RETURN coActor.name, COUNT(*) AS timesWorkedTogether ORDER BY timesWorkedTogether DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:ACTED_IN]-(coActors:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT coActors) AS NumberOfCoActors
MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) RETURN COUNT(DISTINCT director) AS NumberOfDirectors, COLLECT(DISTINCT director.name) AS DirectorNames

MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) RETURN director.name AS DirectorName, COUNT(director) AS NumberOfMoviesDirected ORDER BY split(director.name, " ")[-1]
MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) RETURN director.name, COUNT(*) AS collaborations ORDER BY collaborations DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:ACTED_IN]->(m:Movie)<-[:DIRECTED]-(director:Person) RETURN director.name, m.title ORDER BY m.title
MATCH (tom:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"})-[:FOLLOWS]->(father:Person) RETURN father.name AS FatherName

MATCH (tom:Person {name: 'Tom Hanks'})-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie:Movie) WITH tom, movie MATCH (other:Person)-[:ACTED_IN]->(movie) WHERE other <> tom WITH tom, other, count(movie) AS movieCount RETURN other.name, movieCount ORDER BY movieCount DESC LIMIT 1
MATCH (tomHanks:Person {name: "Tom Hanks"}) MATCH (otherPerson:Person) WHERE otherPerson.born = tomHanks.born RETURN otherPerson.name
MATCH p=shortestPath((jm:Movie {title: "Jerry Maguire"})-[*]-(matrix:Movie {title: "The Matrix"})) RETURN p
MATCH p=shortestPath((m1:Movie {title: "Jerry Maguire"})-[*]-(m2:Movie {title: "Top Gun"})) RETURN p
